name: LiquidAI d1 (d1-2B, d1-3B, d1-omni-600M)

lineage.base_model: d1-2B: LiquidAI/LFM3-VL-2B; d1-3B: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-3B; d1-omni-600M: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-Encoder-350M
lineage.how_derived: decision models returning calibrated answers in one forward pass without generating tokens

purpose: Any pipeline step that needs a decision: routing and triage, moderation, intent and topic classification, extraction from documents and forms, judging and reranking, visual inspection; not a chat model (card). d1-2B also extracts spans, locates objects and estimates quantities with an interval.

license.name: LFM Open License v1.0
license.notes: LICENSE read: Apache-2.0-style grant with a Commercial Use limitation (Threshold = annual revenue of 10M USD or more; non-profits qualified separately); only the definitions and the grant sections were read, not the full Commercial Use section 5, so verified stays false. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.why_this_design: not stated beyond edge-sized decision latency; the open-d1 blog post was not read

benchmarks.name: Decision Index 0.2.1
benchmarks.variant: d1-3B, official scorer, not a leaderboard submission; Winnow-12B 50.02, Decider 35B-A3B 47.11, JPT-9B 46.89

strengths: A decision model reads a state (text, JSON, images) and a schema of typed questions and returns calibrated probabilities for every option in one forward pass; it does not generate text.
milliseconds per decision, 16 languages including German
d1-3B tops the Tools column (74.5) of the Decision Index 0.2.1 table
weaknesses: knowledge-heavy questions favor larger models; answers get less reliable past about 64K tokens of state; free-quantity estimates are less reliable than counts and scores
best_for: on-device routing and classification, edge hardware
soft.maturity: Liquid AI line with edge focus; d1-3B 20k downloads, 511 likes; d1-2B 16k, 329 likes

tona_fit.reason: Small (2 to 6 GB), German listed, millisecond decisions; fits every class as a guardrail or router. A pipeline step, not a worker.

open_questions: d1-2B Decision Index number (card says best open d1 but no number was read)
